To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the strip-line on-chips inductors integrated with magnetic film can achieve high inductance, large current density, and low power loss.
the on-chip inductors integrated with amorphous magnetic film can be used as a power supply for system on chip.
we fabricated a strip line on-chip inductors with large current carrying density by using magnetic films.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the integration of high density inductors with large current density capability on chip substrate.
the integration of on-chip inductors with a magnetic film for a voltage regulator.
the integration of magnetic film on strip-line on-chips to realize high DC current density on-chip inductors.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a strip-line on chip inductor with separate windings wrapped by a boron-incorporate amorphous CoZrTaB film has been developed and its response to an applied dc current was studied.
the on-chip inductors with magnetic film are promising to achieve high current density, high inductance and low power loss for voltage regulators.

the strip-line on-chipp inductor with separate windings wrapped by amorphous film can be used as an inductor for the on-chip voltage regulator with high current density capability and high efficiency.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a large current carrying capability is obtained in a strip-line inductor with high quality factor and inductance density by utilizing magnetic film.
the inductor has a large current density of 1.8×10 ^{6} A/cm ^{2} and a large quality factor ( Q ) of 8 at a high current of 1 A, and a high power density of 0.6 W/cm ^{3} at a low current of 0.5 A.

we successfully demonstrated the integration of high DC current density on-chip inductors with magnetic film and that the magnetic film can provide a good magnetic shielding for the on-chip inductive device.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the on-chip inductors integrated with magnetic film can be used in the high current density applications.
the inductance of the on-chip inductors can be maintained at a constant value even at high dc currents up to 2 A.
the inductance and Q factor of the inductors were not significantly changed by the dc currents of 0.5–2 A.
